# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Shel is a penetration-testing tool and as such, bugs in it can have real-world security impact. If you find a vulnerability in Shel itself, please do **not** open a public issue.

**Instead, report it privately** by emailing the maintainers or opening a private security advisory at:

https://github.com/shri7-lab/Shel/security/advisories/new

### What to include
- Affected module/file and version
- Steps to reproduce (as concise as possible)
- Impact assessment
- Suggested fix (if you have one)

You should receive a response within 72 hours. Please give us time to fix and release before disclosing publicly.

## Responsible Use

Shel is designed for authorized security testing only. You are responsible for complying with all applicable laws and obtaining written permission before testing any system. The maintainers are not liable for misuse.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| latest release | Yes |
| main branch   | Best-effort |
| older releases | No |
